Description: Listing, search and product detail.
Cart, checkout, coupons, tax and payment.
Order history, invoice, tracking and returns.
Customer accounts and staff back-office.

Summary: Product listing with filters, sort & pagination
Description: Shoppers can combine category, brand and price filters, sort results, and page through large categories; works on mobile.
Shoppers get autocomplete suggestions as they type, and a helpful message when there are no results.
A product page shows images, description and a tax-inclusive price with discount, and a variant selector where each variant is its own SKU with its own stock.
Shoppers can add, change quantity and remove items; the cart persists across sessions for logged-in users and shows totals.
A short checkout: address (with PIN serviceability check), delivery method, review with totals and taxes, payment, then confirmation. Guest checkout to be supported subject to BR-4.
Shoppers can enter a promo code and see the discount reflected in the totals before paying.

Summary: Payment via provider-agnostic module + test-mode mock
Description: Payments go through a single PaymentProvider interface with a built-in test-mode mock (success/failure/pending) that fires the confirmation callback internally, so checkout works end-to-end with no live credentials. An order is confirmed only after the callback succeeds; a failed payment keeps the cart for retry. HUMAN-CONFIG REQUIRED (post-build): live keys + merchant KYC. Card data is never stored.
Compute GST per line (CGST+SGST intra-state, IGST inter-state) and show tax-inclusive prices, retaining the split for the invoice.
Customers see their orders and an order-detail page with items, amounts and a status timeline (Confirmed → Packed → Shipped → Delivered) using a mock AWB.
Customers can download the GST tax-invoice PDF for an order, and a credit note is produced when a refund is issued.

Summary: Return or cancel from the order page
Description: Customers can request a return for eligible items within the return window, and cancel an order before it ships (releasing reserved stock). Return window UNDECIDED — Finance 7 days, CX 10 days.
Customers can register (email + hashed password), log in and out, and reset a forgotten password via an expiring link.
Merchandisers can create, edit, publish and unpublish products, variants and prices without engineering — the core reason for the rebuild.
Staff can view and update orders, issue refunds/credit notes and process returns, with role-based access, and see a dashboard of sales and stock (with low-stock flags).

Summary: Reserved stock not released on abandoned order
Description: If checkout starts but payment never completes, reserved stock isn't released, causing phantom out-of-stock. Needs the 15-minute reservation timeout.

Summary: Coupon still applies on its expiry date
Description: A coupon expiring today is still accepted after expiry (off-by-one); it should be rejected once expired.
